channel.title: The Motley Fool UK - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Motley Fool UK (fool.co.uk)

item.title: Why I bought the dip on this FTSE 250 stock this week
item.description: Despite some uninspiring results, Stephen Wright thinks this FTSE 250 firm with a market value of just £2bn is looking at a potential £39bn opportunity.

item.title: How much would I need invested in an ISA to earn £2,317 a month in passive income?
item.description: I ran the numbers to see what it takes in an ISA to earn £2,317 a month, showing how disciplined contributions and compounding really add up.

item.title: New to investing? Here's how to find passive income opportunities
item.description: The stock market's a great place to look for passive income opportunities. But there are a few things to keep in mind when looking for them.

item.title: How much do you need in a Stocks and Shares ISA to generate enough passive income for a ‘comfortable’ retirement?
item.description: An investment ISA can be a very effective retirement saving account. But how much money do you need to create a decent income stream?

item.title: What could £10,000 in a Stocks and Shares ISA be worth 10 years from now?
item.description: The long-term average annual return from a Stocks and Shares ISA has been around 9.5%. But how can investors look to achieve this going forward?

item.title: If the stock market crashes in 2026, there's 1 S&P 500 stock I'll buy
item.description: The S&P 500 index is home to loads of world-class businesses. So why does one healthcare robotics stock stand out to this writer?

item.title: Forget Lloyds: I just bought shares in another bank
item.description: Lloyds shares are rising at the moment. But Edward Sheldon believes that this bank stock will provide better returns in the medium to long term.

item.title: Here's how you could turn the stock market into a £1,055 monthly passive income machine
item.description: Jon Smith discusses how a portfolio with a generous 7% average yield could be targeted, and points out a specific FTSE 250 example.

item.title: Could buying NIO stock be like investing in Tesla a decade ago?
item.description: NIO stock has been going nowhere fast lately. But as sales at the electric vehicle maker boom, should this writer think about investing?

item.title: 3 ways a SIPP can turbocharge your retirement savings
item.description: Edward Sheldon looks at the benefits of SIPPs for retirement saving and highlights a growth-oriented investment worth considering.
